response.sql: WITH order_counts AS (SELECT account_id, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM `order` GROUP BY account_id), overall_avg AS (SELECT AVG(order_count) AS avg_count FROM order_counts), above_average AS (SELECT oc.account_id, oc.order_count, oc.order_count - oa.avg_count AS above_account_average FROM order_counts oc CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa WHERE oc.order_count > oa.avg_count), above_group_avg AS (SELECT AVG(order_count) AS avg_count FROM above_average) SELECT aa.account_id, aa.order_count, aa.above_account_average, aa.order_count - aga.avg_count AS above_above_average FROM above_average aa CROSS JOIN above_group_avg aga ORDER BY above_above_average DESC, aa.account_id LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: The first average includes only accounts with at least one standing order, as specified by the opening clause.

alternatives.interpretation: The first average includes every account, counting accounts without standing orders as zero.
